_comment: Which upstream CRM revision this repo currently carries.
Upstream is the client developer's own repo. It is not a git remote of
this one and the histories are unrelated: each drop arrives as a file
copy, because this repo also holds the local fixes in tools/local-fixes.mjs
and the deployment wiring (api/, vercel.json, src/server/) that upstream
has no equivalent of. So the only record of where we are up to is this
tools/apply-upstream-drop.mjs reads 'sha' to work out what is new, and
writes it back after a successful apply. The scheduled job in
.github/workflows/upstream-drop.yml commits that change on the pull
request it opens, so merging the PR is what records the drop as taken.
Do not edit 'sha' by hand unless an apply has been done by hand.
